mapper.sql: SELECT material_id, material_code, material_name, hazard_class, cas_no, max_storage, storage_unit, storage_area_id, storage_area_name, sds_attachment, toxic_flag, current_stock, safety_stock_min, safety_stock_max, default_supplier_id, flash_point, explosion_limit, physical_properties, hazard_summary, first_aid_measures, fire_fighting, leak_handling, storage_precaution, exposure_control, stability_reactivity, toxicological_info, ecological_info, disposal_info, transport_info, enterprise_id, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_safety_material
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_safety_material ( material_code, material_name, hazard_class, cas_no, max_storage, storage_unit, storage_area_id, storage_area_name, sds_attachment, toxic_flag, current_stock, safety_stock_min, safety_stock_max, default_supplier_id, flash_point, explosion_limit, physical_properties, hazard_summary, first_aid_measures, fire_fighting, leak_handling, storage_precaution, exposure_control, stability_reactivity, toxicological_info, ecological_info, disposal_info, transport_info, enterprise_id, status, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{hazardClass}, #{casNo}, #{maxStorage}, #{storageUnit}, #{storageAreaId}, #{storageAreaName}, #{sdsAttachment}, #{toxicFlag}, #{currentStock}, #{safetyStockMin}, #{safetyStockMax}, #{defaultSupplierId}, #{flashPoint}, #{explosionLimit}, #{physicalProperties}, #{hazardSummary}, #{firstAidMeasures}, #{fireFighting}, #{leakHandling}, #{storagePrecaution}, #{exposureControl}, #{stabilityReactivity}, #{toxicologicalInfo}, #{ecologicalInfo}, #{disposalInfo}, #{transportInfo}, #{enterpriseId}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_safety_material SET del_flag = '2' WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
UPDATE biz_safety_material SET del_flag = '2' WHERE material_id IN #{materialId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM biz_safety_material m WHERE m.del_flag = '0' AND m.status = '0' AND ( (m.safety_stock_max IS NOT NULL AND m.safety_stock_max > 0 AND m.current_stock IS NOT NULL AND m.current_stock > m.safety_stock_max) OR (m.safety_stock_min IS NOT NULL AND m.safety_stock_min > 0 AND m.current_stock IS NOT NULL AND m.current_stock < m.safety_stock_min) OR (m.max_storage IS NOT NULL AND m.current_stock IS NOT NULL AND m.current_stock > m.max_storage) ) ORDER BY m.material_name
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_safety_material SET current_stock = #{afterStock}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
